svg.title: Yeony — Small ideas. Useful possibilities.
svg.desc: Yeony creative tools. A thick, beveled Möbius belt shown at an angle that reveals its half-twist, with bright bands flowing continuously along its surface. Six short face-normal markers rotate around all three local axes: negative X, positive Y, and negative Z. The Z rotation follows the original clockwise orbit in the reference front view. Each axis completes a revolution in 30 seconds.

g.aria-label: A thick beveled Möbius belt. Three contrasting bands circulate along the surface while the twist stays fixed.
